career_ladder.note: Constables in the West Bengal Police are appointed into the subordinate police service. Promotion progression is governed by the West Bengal Police Regulations (PRB), statutory service rules, and the West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019 (ROPA 2019). Advancement to Assistant Sub-Inspector occurs via departmental promotional examinations and seniority-cum-merit.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to the post of Constable and Lady Constable in West Bengal Police is conducted by the West Bengal Police Recruitment Board (WBPRB) through a multi-tier selection process: Preliminary Written Test (PWT), Physical Measurement Test (PMT), Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Final Written Examination, and Interview. Marks scored in the Preliminary Test are screening only; final merit is prepared on the aggregate of Final Written Examination (85 marks) and Interview (15 marks).

financial_package.note: Pay scale for West Bengal Police Constables is sanctioned under Pay Level 6 of the West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019 (ROPA 2019), corresponding to pre-revised Pay Band-2 (₹5,400 – ₹25,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,600). Entry basic pay is ₹22,700.
financial_package.pay_source_label: West Bengal Police Recruitment Board Notice & WBS (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019, Schedule I, Level 6
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on ROPA 2019 Level 6 entry basic pay of ₹22,700 with project constant 58% Dearness Allowance (₹13,166), 12% House Rent Allowance (₹2,724), Medical Allowance (₹500/month), plus statutory police allowances including ration subsidy and kit/washing allowance. Deductions include West Bengal Professional Tax (PTax ₹150–₹200) and General Provident Fund / NPS contributions.
official_perks: Government police barrack accommodation or 12% House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Coverage under the West Bengal Health Scheme (WBHS) for police personnel and eligible dependents
Subsidized police dietary / ration allowance for field and active duty personnel
Annual uniform allowance, kit replacement, and monthly washing allowance
Special risk and compensatory field allowances during riot control, election, and emergency bandobast duties
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment under West Bengal Service Rules

competition_benchmarks.note: West Bengal Police Constable recruitment is one of the highest-volume mass employment drives in Eastern India. Notified vacancies and recruitment notices are verified directly from WBPRB employment notices. Applicant figures are reported based on official board announcements released during examination scheduling.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 98 (calculated: reported applicants ÷ revised notified vacancies)
